## Hawaii Packing List

### Clothing
- Lightweight swimsuits (2-3)
- Quick-dry swim trunks
- Cover-ups or sarongs
- Loose, breathable clothing for beach days
- Light layers for cooler evenings
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Sandals for beach
- Hiking shoes for trails
- Formal attire for dinners or special events

### Toiletries & Essentials
- Sunscreen (broad-spectrum SPF 30+)
- Sunscreen for face and body
- Lip balm with SPF
- Insect repellent
- Travel-sized shampoo, conditioner, body wash
- Toothbrush, toothpaste, floss
- Travel-sized deodorant
- Hair ties/brush
- Towels (quick-dry)
- Beach towels
- Travel-sized laundry detergent
- Reusable water bottle
- Snorkel mask
- Beach towel

### Electronics
- Smartphone with charger
- Travel adapter
- Portable power bank
- Camera or GoPro
- Travel-sized universal adapter
- Earbuds/headphones
- Universal travel adapter

### Miscellaneous
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, insurance)
- Travel insurance card
- Cash and credit cards
- Travel-sized first aid kit
